anomalies.observed: The ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch is drawn as T8 with part/value AO3400A.
anomalies.expected: The specification selects an AON6407 8-DFN N-MOSFET for the ATO valve switch (T3 in the spec), giving a higher-voltage-rated device for the 24 V inductive load.

evidence.quote: T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch

anomalies.impact: The valve driver uses a lower-rated 30 V MOSFET instead of the intended 60 V part; under 24 V inductive transients this can reduce margin, increase heating, or cause premature failure.

anomalies.observed: PR4 LIDAR is connected to the main I2C bus via NET0035/NET0017 and powered from +5V.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the TF-Luna LiDAR is present in documentation/BOM but its pins are free and it is not wired into any net in r2.
